News and notices

SharePointNews

News flows C1, C2 and C3a.

Site PagesSite Pages library · 11 columns

The Site Pages library on BOTH news sites (HPUK News and Other News), with identical columns and internal names. News posts are pages with PromotedState 2. Content approval is off: publishers are pre-approved, so a published page is live straight away.

Delivery LogList · 10 columns

One row per dispatch key from C2 and C3. Title is the dispatch key, unique and indexed: the flows reserve it (Reserved) before sending, then set Sent, Failed (definitely not delivered; the only status that is ever retried) or Reconcile (outcome unknown; a person checks with the recipient and sets Failed to allow a resend). A row left Reserved is not proof of delivery (the run may have stopped before sending): set it to Sent only when the recipient confirms, otherwise Failed. Edit rights: flow identity and configuration maintainers only; readers: support owner.
